market_question: Will Silver (SI) hit (HIGH) $120 by end of June?
reasoning: Silver would need to appreciate over 240% from its current ~$35/oz to $120 in just 15 months, a move far exceeding any historical rally. The all-time high is ~$50 (1980, 2011), and even the 2010-2011 bull run saw only ~188% gain over a similar period from a lower base. Such a surge would require extreme demand shocks or monetary collapse, both of which are tail events with very low probability. The market's 6.7% implied probability significantly overstates the true likelihood.
evidence_points: Silver's all-time high is $49.45 (1980) and $48.70 (2011) – $120 is 2.4x above that
Current spot price ~$35 means a 3.4x multiplier needed; historical 15-month returns never exceeded ~190%
CME silver futures' active month settlement price reflects a highly liquid, institutional market; a $120 print would require a speculative mania well beyond anything seen
sources_consulted: Silver supply/demand and bull run records (various financial news archives)
